title: Chapter 453 A Terrifying Blow
content:
Chapter 453 A Terrifying Blow

At this time, Qinghai slowly opened his eyes, and the two looked at each other, everything was indifferent.

The battle began, and the two rushed towards each other at the same time.

The momentum is surging.

The powerful air wave poured towards the surroundings centered on the two of them.

If there are people around you watching the battle at this moment, they will inevitably be affected, and those below the Supreme Realm will be injured and killed.

In the first blow, the two of them tested each other, but they were incomparable.

Qinghai is naturally outstanding in being able to reach the top position.

Looking at Qinghai in the distance, Wang Er became very serious, "The cultivation level of the Supreme Realm does have the powerful body of the Supreme Heaven, and you should have paid a considerable price."

After a brief temptation, Wang Er had already seen some of Qinghai's strength.

In response to this, Qinghai said in a faint voice: "Everyone is each other."

Wang Er practices both physical and physical skills, and has amazing combat power. As we have walked the road, Wang Er has never shown his physical cultivation strength, but now it is seen by Qinghai at a glance.

Rumble!

After another conflict between the two sides, both of them began to take it seriously.

Every time Wang Er punches, various different fist shadows will form, roaring towards Qinghai, with amazing momentum.

Qinghai snorted lightly, his hands changed into dragon claws, pushed forward horizontally, and resisted them all.

Seeing that Qinghai had such ability, Wang Er put his palms together and shouted loudly, "Dharma Heaven and Earth!"

Buzz —

In an instant, a huge golden phantom appeared from Wang Er's body, standing tall and looking proudly at the sky.

This phantom gave Qinghai a great sense of oppression.

Not daring to be careless, Qinghai's body expanded rapidly, and in the blink of an eye it turned into a huge blue dragon, with green dragon scales spreading all over the body and slowly glowing.

The dragon swings its tail!

He threw out a tail hit and barely repelled Wang Er's Dharma image, Heaven and Earth, but then Wang Er killed him again.

It controls the Dharma image and the world, and its every move is filled with the truth of the Great Dao.

In less than a moment, Qinghai was suppressed and panting.

After all, there is still a gap in realm and cannot be compensated.

At this time, Qinglong was covered in scars and blood. On the contrary, Wang Er's face was a little pale. In comparison, it was simply too good.

If Wang Er's body is slightly weaker, he can seize the opportunity to break Wang Er, and the Dharma image of heaven and earth will be destroyed without attacking.

But the two practices of Wang's two bodies have no flaws at all.

As time passed, Qinglong had no power to resist after he used his strongest attack.

Finally won.

Wang Er let out a deep breath of turbid air. At this moment, his Dharma image world was already ruined and cracks were everywhere. He had to admit that Qinghai was really strong.

If the other party can reach the supreme heaven of the earth, it is really hard to say.

But this time, he won.

"My name is Wang Er. Remember this name. If you have a chance in the future, I hope you can fight one more match."

Wang Er looked at Qinghai and said.

Qinghai used all his last bit of strength and slowly raised his eyelids to look at Wang Er.

The huge dragon pupils reflected Wang Er's ordinary body. Qinghai wanted to say something, but he couldn't make a sound. He had to watch Wang Er destroy his vitality.

In this way, the top of the Tianjiao List was replaced again.

Just like the combat power list, the top of the list is once again controlled by the human race.

Seeing this, although it was already expected that the sentient beings outside the Tianjiao List could not help but exclaim.

Wang Er attracted the attention of everyone present. At this moment, no one noticed that the shadow clan's shadow Wujie also began to move upwards, heading towards the top of the genius list.

On the other hand, the war against the entire Chaos Realm continues.

The strong men in the Land of Gods kept looking for loopholes in the light curtain and kept throwing strong men into the Chaos Realm.

Gradually, the strong men in the Chaos Realm began to lose, retreated step by step, and fell into a disadvantage for a while.

Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword in his hand and took over a dozen powerful people from other worlds with his own strength to relieve the pressure on the rest of the powerful people in the Chaos Realm.

Seeing more and more powerful people from other worlds entering the Chaos Realm, Lu Xue knew that the Chaos Realm was no longer an opponent of the Gods.

"Old Formation, activate the formation."

Lu Xue sent a voice to the direction of Qingyang.

Hearing Lu Xue's order, the light suddenly burst into clear and turbid eyes.

"Hahaha, the puppies from the Land of Gods, let you see what the peak of the formation is!"

"Change!"

With a command, the energy of the entire Chaos Realm began to gather quickly towards one place.

And the center of the gathering is the deserted city.

Looking at the whole world, only Huangcheng has the ability to accumulate such huge energy.

As the energy continued to condense, the powerful people in the other world suddenly felt an extremely terrifying sense of oppression.

"No, this formation is strange!"

Seeing this, a strong man from another world suddenly felt relieved.

Immediately afterwards, the other powerful men in the other world began to slowly retreat toward the rear.

Seeing this scene, a strong man from another world led by the leader snorted coldly.

The next moment, all the powerful people in the other world were stunned, and then a strange scene happened.

The aura of these powerful men in other worlds suddenly began to become stronger, and then their eyes turned red, and the offensive became even more violent, and there was no one who retreated.

Wu Hui saw something was wrong and frowned slightly, "These beasts have become stronger through some means, but they seem to have side effects."

Shi Zhong nodded slightly, "These guys seem to have become unreasonable, just like crazy people."

Seeing that the strong men in the other world had the advantage again, the Chaos Realm began to slowly retreat.

And at this moment, a dazzling sword light hit.

In an instant, the sky turned pale.

A white light flashed, and everyone was separated from the powerful people in another world.

Lu Xue was wearing a green robe and stood proudly in front of everyone, holding the Xuanyuan Sword in his hand, pointing the sword at everyone in another world.

"kill!"

With Lu Xue's whisper, the deserted city shook violently.

boom!

A huge golden pillar of light gushed out from the deserted city, cutting through the sky, and rushing towards the creatures in another world at an astonishing speed.

Wherever you pass, the space is broken.

It washes away the lives of sentient beings in other worlds like a long river.

All living creatures in other worlds who rise up and resist die here.

The powerful men in the Chaos Realm looked at the pillar of light with complex eyes, and they all felt their insignificance.

With just one blow, everyone realized that the entire Chaos Realm seemed to have lost its color.

There was another loud bang.

The light column crashed into the light curtain outside the boundary, making a magnificent loud noise.

Unstoppable!

When the light disappeared and everyone breathed a sigh of relief when they saw that the light curtain was not destroyed.

With just one blow, all the powerful people from other worlds entering the Chaos Realm were eliminated, and the energy of this blow was finally fed back to the light curtain, which can be said to be used to the extreme.

Everyone unconsciously looked at Zhen Qingyang, the master of the formation and the creator of the Chaos Combined Attack Position, with a look of admiration in their eyes.

And Zhen Qingyang also had a proud expression on his face.

No matter what the result is, Zhen Qingyang will definitely make an indelible contribution.
